env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd w

# A member imported under an alias decodes: the generated code spells it with
# the file's own import name.
logos run ./alias
stdout '^alias circle r=3$'
stdout '^alias local s=4$'

# A member package the holder never imports decodes: the lowering adds the import.
logos run ./unimported
stdout '^unimported m\.A \{X:5\}$'
stdout '^unimported m\.B \{Y:y\}$'

# Two member packages with one name and one type name keep separate key sets.
logos run ./samename
stdout '^samename a r=1$'
stdout '^samename b s=2$'

-- w/go.mod --
module example.com/jq

go 1.27

-- w/shape/shape.lgo --
package shape

type Circle struct {
	R int64 `json:"r"`
}

-- w/alias/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"

	xs "example.com/jq/shape"
)

type Local struct {
	S int64 `json:"s"`
}

type U interface {
	xs.Circle | Local
}

type H struct {
	V U `json:"v"`
}

func show(input string) {
	var h H
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(input), &h); err != nil {
		fmt.Println("error", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	switch v := h.V.(type) {
	case xs.Circle:
		fmt.Printf("alias circle r=%d\n", v.R)
	case Local:
		fmt.Printf("alias local s=%d\n", v.S)
	case nil:
		fmt.Println("alias nil")
	}
}

func main() {
	show(`{"v":{"r":3}}`)
	show(`{"v":{"s":4}}`)
}

-- w/m/m.lgo --
package m

type A struct {
	X int64 `json:"x"`
}

type B struct {
	Y string `json:"y"`
}

-- w/u/u.lgo --
package u

import "example.com/jq/m"

type U interface {
	m.A | m.B
}

-- w/unimported/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"

	"example.com/jq/u"
)

type H struct {
	V u.U `json:"v"`
}

func show(input string) {
	var h H
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(input), &h); err != nil {
		fmt.Println("error", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	fmt.Printf("unimported %T %+v\n", h.V, h.V)
}

func main() {
	show(`{"v":{"x":5}}`)
	show(`{"v":{"y":"y"}}`)
}

-- w/a/shape/shape.lgo --
package shape

type Item struct {
	R int64 `json:"r"`
}

-- w/b/shape/shape.lgo --
package shape

type Item struct {
	S int64 `json:"s"`
}

-- w/samename/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"

	a "example.com/jq/a/shape"
	b "example.com/jq/b/shape"
)

type U interface {
	a.Item | b.Item
}

type H struct {
	V U `json:"v"`
}

func show(input string) {
	var h H
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(input), &h); err != nil {
		fmt.Println("error", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	switch v := h.V.(type) {
	case a.Item:
		fmt.Printf("samename a r=%d\n", v.R)
	case b.Item:
		fmt.Printf("samename b s=%d\n", v.S)
	case nil:
		fmt.Println("samename nil")
	}
}

func main() {
	show(`{"v":{"r":1}}`)
	show(`{"v":{"s":2}}`)
}
